text:
ana: quick note: annotator v1.2.3 started throwing 503s in prod after midnight. built 1.2.3-hotfix with header parse guard. requesting expedited deploy to canary. @remy @tom
deploybot: queued: deploy/annotator v1.2.3-hotfix -> canary (us-west1)
remy: failure pattern looks payload-specific (large headers). can we gate by header-size in ingress while rolling?
tom: add short-circuit in nginx layer? prefer minimal infra change; team wants image swap only.
ops-bot: current change window closes in 12m. expedited ok if SRE + eng leads ack.
ana: rollback policy proposed: error_rate > 1.5% over 5m OR 5xx spike > 3/min. auto-rollback ON. pin canary 5% for 3m then 30% for 7m.
remy: +1, also alert channels and incident link.
deploybot: starting canary 5% -> us-west1. monitoring enabled.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-078 annotator-503s. paging oncall.
tom: seeing decreased 5xxs in canary logs. promoting to 30%.
remy: no p95 regressions. continuing to observe 10m.
deploybot: promoted to 30% -> promoting rules met.
ana: if stable for 10m promote to 100%, else rollback immediately.
ops-bot: recorded deploy note and will update release log after green.
remy: green at 100% now, closing INC-2026-078. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
